subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw handle Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan API keys that pass setup but fail on the general Volcengine DeepSeek route?
rationale: Source inspection can show the current endpoint split and shallow setup validation, but only maintainer intent plus credentialed provider proof can decide whether to reroute, narrow defaults, or improve diagnostics without breaking valid Volcengine users.

options.title: Validate entitlement before changing routing
options.body: Have a maintainer or credentialed tester check the same Lite key shape against the general DeepSeek route and the Coding Plan route, then implement the smallest plugin-owned change that matches the observed provider contract.

options.title: Route Lite users to Coding Plan
options.body: If live proof shows Lite keys are coding-endpoint-only, update Volcengine setup/defaults/docs/tests so Lite users land on the coding provider instead of the general DeepSeek row.

options.title: Keep routing and improve diagnostics
options.body: If the general DeepSeek route intentionally requires a different entitlement, keep the catalog split but surface a clear setup/runtime message explaining the key/model mismatch.

recommendation.title: Validate entitlement before changing routing
recommendation.body: Have a maintainer or credentialed tester check the same Lite key shape against the general DeepSeek route and the Coding Plan route, then implement the smallest plugin-owned change that matches the observed provider contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, setup behavior, and the current Volcengine plugin boundary where this history is strongest.
